    n = len(A)
    # Forward elimination

        for j in range(i, n):

def gaussian_elimination(A, B):
    n = len(A)
    # Create augmented matrix
    M = [A[i][:] + [B[i]] for i in range(n)]
    
    # Forward elimination
    for i in range(n):
        # Find pivot
        max_row = i
        for r in range(i+1, n):
            if abs(M[r][i]) > abs(M[max_row][i]):

        M[i], M[max_row] = M[max_row], M[i]

        if abs(M[i][i]) < 1e-10:
            continue
            
        # Eliminate
        for r in range(i+1, n):
            factor = M[r][i] / M[i][i]
            for c in range(i, n+1):
                M[r][c] -= factor * M[i][c]
    
    # Back substitution
    x = [0] * n
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
